Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00411
⌈If development error detection for the Fr module is enabled, then the function Fr_
GetVersionInfo() shall check whether the parameter VersioninfoPtr is a NULL
pointer (NULL_PTR). If VersioninfoPtr is a NULL pointer, then the function Fr_
GetVersionInfo() shall raise the development error FR_E_PARAM_POINTER and
return.⌋
